decisions.reason: Report cites index.js:3 (inject=["apiProxy"]) and index.js:9 (ctx.apiProxy.llm.providers()), maps to the APIProxy-removal card DSH-0.1.2-A1-01 (via API-01), explains the llm injection/listProviders target pattern, and analyzes the stale @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy@0.0.1-rc.1 pin in package.json:17 with break symptoms (service never provided / resolution failure). Full evidence, not a card name alone.

All six non-hit categories are tabulated with concrete scanned-file evidence (e.g., ctx.effect in index.js:7 distinguished from event subscription). session-notes.js correctly cleared as pure string/array utilities. cordis.patch.yml correctly classified as an ordinary insert composition overlay, not a host-source patch, quoting its content; no invented coupling and no denial of the file's existence.

Section 3 explicitly states zero hits ≠ compatible, lists static-scan coverage gaps (dependency graph, runtime mounting/inject waiting, behavioral drift, pack artifact), and separates the single decisive apiProxy break from the six negative categories, concluding the plugin is NOT compatible as-is.

Section 3 proposes a post-migration ladder explicitly 'not run in this task': build/typecheck against the alpha.2 cohort, isolated-profile cold boot / dump-config, real mount confirming no 'waiting' state, and an actual ctx.llm.listProviders() call, plus a pack artifact smoke.
